title: Identify superseded duplicate living Reports without deleting history
description:
A historical retry can leave two living Reports linked to the same Task and optimization run. Even after the Task finishes, the earlier copy can remain visibly running with an obsolete first revision. Operators need the dashboard to identify the authoritative revision while preserving both records.

Feature: Read-only duplicate Report reconciliation

Scenario: two Reports identify the same Task and run
Given two optimization Reports share one Task and run key
And one Report has a later durable revision
When the Reports dashboard renders them
Then the later revision is treated as authoritative
And the earlier Report is labeled superseded
And the earlier Report links to the authoritative Report

Scenario: retries use different Tasks
Given two optimization Reports share a run key but belong to different Tasks
When the dashboard renders them
Then neither is treated as a duplicate of the other

Scenario: revision evidence is tied
Given duplicate Reports have the same latest revision number
When the dashboard resolves the authoritative Report
Then the most recently updated Report wins with a stable ID tie-breaker.

No Report, Task, block, artifact, or GraphQL resource is deleted or rewritten.
